correctness.rationale: Source RESULT.md blob 510be494666cae95cae5e8dad4d481f0478616a5: relative displacement y mod ell gives four transport velocities (+/-)(v1-v2) and (+/-)(v1+v2). The backward BVP w_s partial_y f_s + alpha Qf_s=-1 requires mixed absorbing endpoints f_s(ell)=0 only for positive velocity and f_s(0)=0 for negative velocity. Because all w_s are nonzero, its boundary operator is invertible at alpha=0 and analytic nearby. The exact polynomial recursion w_s f_{k,s} prime=-(Qf_{k-1})_s integrates to M0=ell*v1/[2(v1²-v2²)], M1=ell²(v1²-5v2²)/[6(v1²-v2²)²], M2=2ell³v1*v2²/[3(v1²-v2²)³], including positive threshold value 25ell³/(96v1³). Independent symbolic algebra reconstructed all four recursions, verified BVP residuals and boundary conditions, and integrated the coefficients. For alpha large, compensated sign-flip martingale has quadratic variation 4alpha t, implying expected maximum squared integrated signs O(t/alpha+alpha^-2); for each finite t, collision probability tends to zero after excluding small initial gaps. Hence E T_alpha diverges, continuity plus negative M1 yields positive finite global minimizer above threshold. Finite numerical simulations are not evidence of this limit.
residual_risks: Strict 0<v2<v1, common independent reversal rate; equal-speed limit singular.
Only local weak-rate sign and existence of a positive global minimizer in beneficial regime; no uniqueness or global ballistic optimality below threshold.
